Metadata.title: ClearLedger | Invoice Finance for Trade
Metadata.description: ClearLedger coordinates SMEs, their buyers and USDC liquidity providers through an on-chain invoice lifecycle on Stellar.

welcome.title: Welcome to ClearLedger
welcome.body: Your wallet is connected. This quick tour shows where everything lives. Press Escape at any time to leave it.

role.title: Pick your role
role.body: SMEs (issuers) record invoices, buyers confirm delivery and repay, and liquidity providers supply USDC. Switch roles here; available actions depend on your profile.

balances.title: Your wallet balances
balances.body: Live USDC and XLM balances for the connected Freighter wallet. XLM pays network fees; USDC is what invoices are funded and repaid in.

dashboard.title: SME Dashboard
dashboard.body: Issuers create invoices, track funding and repayments, and work through the Get Started checklist here.

lp.title: LP Portal
lp.body: Liquidity providers can review pool activity, supply USDC and redeem shares subject to available liquidity. Returns are variable and losses are possible.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.body: Browse invoices listed for funding, with their discount, due date and issuer status.

profile.title: Profile & verification
profile.body: Your profile is recorded in the on-chain ClearLedger registry. A designated protocol administrator must verify your profile before gated actions are available.

done.title: You're all set
done.body: Relaunch this tour any time from the Take the tour button in the navigation bar.

connectPrompt.title: Connect Your Wallet
connectPrompt.body: Connect your Freighter wallet to review invoice financing workflows. Funding depends on verification, invoice assessment and available pool liquidity.

header.title: SME Financing Dashboard
header.createInvoiceLocked: Please complete your profile registration to unlock invoice creation

checklist.title: Get Started
checklist.description: Complete the steps below to unlock full dashboard operations.

emptyState.title: No invoices yet
emptyState.description: Create an invoice record and review its terms before listing it for potential financing.

console.title: Management console
console.emptyState: Select an obligation from the table to load actions in the operator console.

header.title: Invoice Marketplace
header.description: Review invoice records listed for financing on Stellar Soroban.

verificationBanner.title: Profile Verification Required
verificationBanner.body: Your wallet profile is not yet verified. Register a profile, then wait for the protocol administrator to verify it before using gated actions. Go to the <link>[Profile Page]</link> to begin.

emptyState.title: No invoices match your filters
emptyState.description: Try broadening the amount range or resetting the filters to reveal more listed invoices.

console.title: Management Center
console.connectToAct: Connect Freighter to fund, list, or manage this invoice. Public details stay visible.

fundingPreview.title: POOL FINANCING PREVIEW
fundingPreview.note: Funding this invoice deploys USDC from the pool contract into escrow. LPs earn the discount difference upon repayment.

emptyState.title: NO INVOICE SELECTED
emptyState.description: Select an obligation from the ledger table to view its parameters and execute smart contract actions.
